model: PTV JETS 3.8/60-COMPACT high-pressure pump (manual M-01/2007-EN, file name notes: old version with double-groove piston and mechanical-shift intensifier)

technical_parameters_60K.hydraulic_oil_fill_l: 160 (170 for a change), tank net volume 210 l
technical_parameters_60K.oil_pump: PARKER PV063, 63.0 cm3/rev, proportional valve controlled
technical_parameters_60K.ambient: +5 (15 after start-up) to +35 C, 85 % RH max; machine room +10 to +30 C recommended
technical_parameters_60K.clearances_mm: 550 left (cooler air), 400 rear, 1100 right and front
technical_parameters_60K.noise: 88.7 dB(A) in machine room, 80.1 dB(A) operator exposure per 8 h shift

technical_parameters_40K.note: same frame; 40K intensifier gives more flow at lower pressure rating

electrical_installation.supply_cable: CYKY 4x25 or 5x25 mm2 up to 15 m (protection 100 A), CYKY 4x35 / 5x35 mm2 if longer (protection 125 A)
electrical_installation.internal_fuses: P1 knife fuses 80 A, Q1 main switch 100 A
electrical_installation.pe_conductor: CYA 16 mm2 yellow-green to the main distributor
electrical_installation.supply_height: 2500 mm above the machine-room floor, next to the distributor

main_distributor_elements.K1, K2, K3: power contactors 60 A star/delta start of M1
main_distributor_elements.M2: oil cooler fan/pump motor 1.5 kW 3x400 V (F3 6 A, contactor K4)
main_distributor_elements.M3: inlet water booster pump 0.75 kW 1x230 V (F6 6 A, relay R2) - option 'TVV'
main_distributor_elements.F7: primary breaker of isolating transformer TR1

control_distributor_elements.TR2: feeding transformer control panel and distributor
control_distributor_elements.U1: automatic control PLC (basic unit + RS485 module + temperature + analogue modules)
control_distributor_elements.S0, S1: hydraulic piston position sensors (electric-shift intensifier only)
control_distributor_elements.S6: reverse filter clogged pressure switch P3
control_distributor_elements.S21, S22: T3, T4 check valve temperature sensors

control_panel.H1: green pilot lamp machine in operation

hydraulic_scheme_PTV-011-D-0173_position.39 P3: booster pressure switch (on 3.7 bar / off 4.5 bar)
hydraulic_scheme_PTV-011-D-0173_position.40 TN: pressure tank with bladder (1.2 bar air)

display_abbreviations.HPW: output HP water pressure (calculated from oil pressure if no P4 sensor)

password_levels.A: service: reset Mth counters for check valve lapping and oil/filter change; 'Switch delay' timer; 'Default' restore. The 4-digit level-A password is kept locally by AMC (file 'Pump Password.txt', not published).
password_levels.B: all Settings (BD timer, change timers, presets, linearization, constant mult.) - producer service engineers
password_levels.menu_path_for_password: Right arrow -> MAIN MENU -> down to PASSWORD -> right arrow -> MODE -> type 4 digits -> ENTER (level shown bottom-left for 5 minutes) -> ESC

service_intervals.water_filter_cartridges: replace when differential > 1.2 bar running, at least once a year
service_intervals.first_160_Mth: check tightness of all connections frequently
service_intervals.counter_reset: MAIN MENU -> SERVICING -> 'Servis CHV done?' / 'Servis oil done?' with level-A password (see procedure documents)

alarm_thresholds.cooler_control: fan on at 50 C, off at 45 C (T1 on tank); operating oil temperature 45-50 C
alarm_thresholds.normal_oil_pressure: approx. 215 bar cold with ON/OFF valve closed, 205-212 bar warm, 180-210 bar while cutting; manometer MP2 swing 170-210 bar

torques.intensifier_end_cap: hand tight with spanner + light mallet taps, max 75 Nm (pump manual) / 115 Nm with H2O Jet torque tool (intensifier manual)
torques.tie_rod_nuts: stepwise 27, 54, 81, 108, 135, 163 Nm in figure-eight pattern on the assembly fixture (pump manual: 27 Nm seat only)
torques.onoff_valve_nozzle_body_and_actuator: 47-54 Nm (35-40 ft-lb), actuator with 60 psi air applied

lubricants.400001-1: Blue anti-galling lubricant (Blue Goop) - all HP threads and stainless-on-stainless contact
lubricants.400034-2: Food grade lubricant - all HP seals and o-rings
lubricants.400015-1: Parker Super O-Lube - o-rings on hydraulic parts
